title: Magical Girl’s Tailor He’s Not the Strongest, but He Makes Her the Strongest by Tailloring Her Dress
description:
“I want to create the best clothes!” Armed with that dream, Kouki, a high school student, is granted the “Clothing Skill” by a legendary goddess and transported to another world.
There, he decides to become a “magician’s tailor.” Alongside the beauty, Scarlet, an aspiring magical girl, he enrolls at the magic academy Merkul—but things don’t go as planned…?!
The so-called failure rises to the top of the magic academy in this otherworld reincarnation × fashion adventure!
author: Aoki Yasuko
